motion: Exact archived quality-evaluation SMPL-X parameters, including the official DualTrack conversion; no generation or refitting.
mesh: Full SMPL-X, 10475 vertices; original shape/expression/hand means retained. Mesh arrays remain in source world coordinates.
display: Shared rigid Y-up to Z-up display rotation, then one constant initial root/floor translation per clip; fixed camera shared across the two models for each sample; no smoothing or speed change.
audio: Each system uses its own archived generated WAV; AAC 192k, original amplitude, no time shift or stretch.
duration: Preserve all source motion frames and all speech; if necessary hold the final pose for one 30-FPS frame and pad trailing audio with silence.
